decision.summary: A correlated multi-sample drop occurs in N/E/U from ~528 to 539, strongest in U with partial recovery but no full return to pre-event trend within allowed context. N and E lack clear opposing edges; the event resembles a transient offset but cannot be confirmed due to incomplete recovery and differing axis behavior.
